environment_setting: Urban area in Country B, where rental properties are in high demand, and landlords often face challenges in monitoring tenant activities.
norm_base: Property Tenant Knowingly permitting premises to be used as brothel imprisonment up to 7 years or fine or both

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: maximize rental income while avoiding legal trouble

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting regular inspections and verifying tenant activities
legitimate.benefits: Ensures compliance with the law, avoids legal consequences, maintains property reputation
legitimate.costs: Time-consuming, potential conflict with tenants, additional expenses for inspections

illegal.illegal_action: Knowingly allowing tenants to use the premises as a brothel
illegal.benefits: Higher rental income, avoids tenant turnover
illegal.costs: Imprisonment up to 7 years, fine, or both if discovered

character_profile.name: Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: operate a brothel discreetly to maximize personal income

legitimate.legitimate_action: Using the rented property for lawful purposes
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble, maintains a stable living arrangement
legitimate.costs: Lower income compared to operating a brothel

illegal.illegal_action: Operating a brothel on the rented premises
illegal.costs: Imprisonment, fine, or both if discovered

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: maintain a safe and peaceful neighborhood

legitimate.legitimate_action: Reporting suspicious activities to the authorities
legitimate.benefits: Ensures neighborhood safety, prevents illegal activities
legitimate.costs: Potential conflict with neighbors, time spent reporting

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring suspicious activities to avoid involvement
illegal.benefits: Avoids personal conflict and time expenditure
illegal.costs: Moral guilt, potential legal consequences if complicity is proven
